mods.name: SaveLogic
mods.description: Cloud saves for singleplayer: keep your worlds, mods and configs in sync between computers through your own private GitHub repository, with version history and fast change-only uploads. Also checks your mods for updates on Modrinth.

releases.notes:
* **Choose Synced Worlds** (☁ > Worlds): lists the worlds on this computer and whether each one syncs with the cloud.
* **Sync** uploads a world, and from then on it syncs automatically. **Stop Syncing** keeps a world on this computer only; its copy already in the cloud is kept and can still be downloaded.
* New worlds stay on your computer until you choose to sync them, so test worlds never go to the cloud.

mods.name: SaveLogic
mods.description: Cloud saves for singleplayer: keep your worlds, mods and configs in sync between computers through your own private GitHub repository, with version history and fast change-only uploads. Also checks your mods for updates on Modrinth.

releases.notes:
* **Schematics sync:** your Litematica `schematics` folder (`.litematic`, `.schem`, `.schematic`, `.nbt`) now stays the same on every computer. It syncs automatically when Minecraft starts and when you leave a world, or with the new **Sync Schematics** button (☁ > Schematics).
* New and changed schematics go both ways and subfolders are kept. A schematic deleted on one computer is deleted on the others at their next sync, after their copy is moved to `savelogic-backups/schematics`.
* If a schematic was changed on two computers before either synced, **both are kept**: the other copy appears as `house (Gaming PC).litematic` on both computers.
* Turn it off with *Settings > Schematics sync* to sync only with the button.
* The cloud menu is now two columns so the new section fits on small windows, and *Test* (connection) sits next to the repository URL in Settings.
* Added an icon, MIT license and Modrinth page links to the mod info.

mods.name: SaveLogic
mods.description: Save and load your singleplayer worlds to a private GitHub repository.

releases.notes:
**Test build for Minecraft 26.3. Back up important worlds before trying it.** Also available for [Minecraft 1.21.11](https://github.com/zinngar/Savelogic/releases/tag/v2.0.0-beta.8%2B1.21.11).

Requires Minecraft **26.3**, Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Fabric API for 26.3 and Java 25. **Remove the previous SaveLogic jar from your mods folder** when adding this one.

### New in beta 8
* **Check for Mod Updates** (☁ > Mods & configs): looks up every mod in your `mods` folder on Modrinth and lists the updates available for your Minecraft version, ticked by default. Libraries an update needs are added automatically. Updates are downloaded, checked against Modrinth's fingerprint, and installed **when you close Minecraft**, after your current mods are backed up to `savelogic-backups`.
* Mods that are up to date, have no build for your Minecraft version yet, or aren't on Modrinth (for example CurseForge-only mods) are listed too, so you can see what couldn't be checked.
* Works without the GitHub settings. To give your other computer the same updates, use *Upload My Mods & Configs* afterwards.
* The Settings and Back buttons on the cloud menu are now side by side.

## SaveLogic 2.0.0

* **Updated to Minecraft 26.3** (Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Java 25). The same version is also available for Minecraft 1.21.11.
* **Cloud saves actually upload now.** Fixed a crash when uploading (OkHttp's Kotlin dependency was missing from the jar) and tokens that were never decrypted after loading the config.
* **Big worlds:** each world is stored as its own GitHub release, named after the world, and split into 1 GB parts instead of committed to the repo, which was capped at 100 MB and grew forever.
* **Downloads over 1 MB work**, and they unzip into their own world folder instead of spilling into `saves/`.
* **Progress bar for uploads and downloads** at the top of the menus (percent, MB, speed, time left), with the result shown when they finish.
* **Cloud Saves is a ☁ button next to Singleplayer**, so it is always on screen at any GUI scale.
* **Test Connection** now checks what you typed, and warns if the token can't write or the repository is public.
* **Check for Mod Updates:** finds newer versions of your mods on Modrinth for your Minecraft version (plus any libraries they need) and installs them after Minecraft closes, with a backup.
* **Fast saves:** after a world's first upload, only the files that changed are uploaded, and computers that are in step download only the changes.
* **One question for old copies:** opening an unsynced world that has the same name as a cloud world asks which copy to use, showing when each was last played; prompts everywhere now show last-played times.
* **Version history and safe syncing between computers:** each world keeps its last versions (5 by default) with the computer and time each was saved, and any version can be restored. Uploads ask before overwriting newer progress from another computer, opening a world warns if it's open elsewhere or there's a newer version, and synced worlds upload automatically when you leave them.
* **Sync your mods and configs:** upload your mods and config folders and install them on another computer; the swap happens after Minecraft closes, with a backup of what was there before.
* Fixed local auto-backups zipping the wrong folder.
* Removed Google Drive support. Existing users need to paste their GitHub token into Settings again.
